title: QuantEval: A Benchmark for Financial Quantitative Tasks in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2601.08689v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong capabilities in finance-oriented question answering, yet their evaluation on professional quantitative workflows remains fragmented and often stops at factual or document-grounded QA. We introduce QuantEval, a benchmark for evaluating whether LLMs can complete the compute--implement--validate loop required in quantitative finance. QuantEval contains 1,575 expert-validated instances across three complementary dimensions: (i) knowledge-based QA, (ii) quantitative mathematical reasoning, and (iii) quantitative strategy coding. The coding task is evaluated with a deterministic CTA-style backtesting framework that executes model-generated strategies and compares risk--return metrics against expert references, moving beyond syntax or template matching. We evaluate 13 open-source and proprietary LLMs, report prompt and reliability analyses, and observe substantial gaps relative to human experts

translated_title: QuantEval：面向大语言模型金融量化任务的基准测试
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在面向金融的问答任务中已展现出强大的能力，但其在专业量化工作流程上的评估仍然较为碎片化，且往往止步于事实性或基于文档的问答。我们提出了QuantEval，这是一个用于评估大语言模型能否完成量化金融中所需的“计算—实现—验证”闭环的基准测试。QuantEval包含1,575个经专家验证的实例，涵盖三个互补的维度：(i) 基于知识的问答，(ii) 量化数学推理，以及 (iii) 量化策略编程。编程任务采用确定性的CTA风格回测框架进行评估，该框架会实际执行模型生成的策略，并将其风险—收益指标与专家参考基准进行比较，从而超越了单纯的语法或模板匹配。我们评估了13个开源及专有大语言模型，报告了提示词与可靠性分析，并观察到模型与人类专家之间仍存在显著差距。
tldr: 该论文提出了QuantEval基准，通过涵盖知识问答、量化数学推理和量化策略编程三个维度的1,575个专家验证实例，并采用确定性CTA回测框架实际执行模型生成的策略，系统评估了13个大语言模型完成量化金融“计算—实现—验证”闭环的能力，发现模型与人类专家之间仍存在显著差距。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces QuantEval, a benchmark of 1,575 expert-validated instances spanning knowledge QA, quantitative mathematical reasoning, and strategy coding, which employs a deterministic CTA-style backtesting framework to evaluate 13 LLMs on the compute-implement-validate loop of quantitative finance, revealing substantial performance gaps relative to human experts.
